summary: Single-page screening flow: folder setup plus criteria config, chunked progress with pause/cancel, results summary with output path and per-resume table mirroring Excel report.

screens.name: Screening setup — folder plus criteria
screens.purpose: Point app at local resume folder and define at least one criterion before start.
sections: App header with title and short description
Folder input block: path text field, Validate/Scan button, helper text noting same-machine path, top-level PDF/DOCX only
Folder status block: file count preview, validation message area
Criteria block: min years experience number input (optional), required keywords tag input with Add button and removable chips
Future-criteria placeholder note: extensible list area for later criteria without redesign
Start screening button plus blocked-hint text
Error area for folder and criteria validation
contentPriority: Folder path input and file count
Start button enabled state plus at-least-one-criterion hint
Min experience input and keyword chips
interactions: Submit path scans top-level PDF/DOCX only, shows count, ignores subfolders and other extensions
Start disabled until folder valid plus at least one criterion set; blocked attempt shows message requiring one criterion
Add keyword appends removable chip; duplicate and blank entries rejected
Clear or change folder resets count and disables start until revalidated
Zero supported files shows no-resumes error and keeps start disabled, creates no output
screens.responsive: Single column under 720px; criteria block stacks below folder block; chips wrap.
accessibility: Labelled path and number inputs with describedby helper text
Keyword chips removable by keyboard with aria-label remove plus live-region announcement
Validation errors use role alert and move focus to error summary
Start disabled state announced, not color-only

screens.name: Screening progress
screens.purpose: Show chunked bulk processing with control until run finishes or stops.
sections: Progress header with folder path and active criteria recap
Progress bar with processed versus found counts and percent
Live counters: processed, qualified so far, not qualified so far, undetermined so far
Current file indicator and chunk note (10 at a time)
Pause/Resume and Cancel buttons
Partial findings note explaining cancel keeps processed results
Error banner area for unreadable-file handling
interactions: Processing advances in chunks of 10 with visible bar update
Pause freezes queue, button becomes Resume; Cancel stops remaining files and jumps to results with partial data
Unreadable files counted as Undetermined, never halt run
Cancel confirms before stopping when work remains
screens.responsive: Counters collapse to 2x2 grid on narrow screens; controls stay full-width touch targets.
accessibility: Progress bar uses role progressbar with aria-valuenow and text equivalent
Pause/Cancel reachable by keyboard with visible focus; live region announces chunk completion without flooding screen reader
Status changes announced politely, errors assertively

screens.name: Results summary and per-resume breakdown
screens.purpose: Explain every resume outcome and point user at dated output folder plus Excel report.
sections: Run summary cards: found, processed, qualified, not qualified, undetermined
Output location block: Jalali-dated folder path, copy-path button, report filename
Criteria-used recap plus screening Jalali/Gregorian date
Per-resume results table: filename, candidate name, estimated years, experience status, technologies detected, required found, required missing, final status, reason
Table filter and search: status filter chips (All/Qualified/Not Qualified/Undetermined) plus text search
Empty-qualified notice when zero qualified: no copies made, report still generated
Start new screening button
contentPriority: Summary counts and output folder path
interactions: Copy-path button copies output folder path with confirmation
Status filter and search narrow table rows without refetch
Row shows full reason text; long skills lists truncate with expand
Start new screening returns to setup preserving last folder and criteria
Failed run shows error state with retry, never links missing output
screens.responsive: Summary cards wrap to single column; table scrolls horizontally with sticky first column and status column; filters wrap.
accessibility: Summary counts as list with text labels, not color-only
Table uses th scope, caption, and status text plus icon with aria-label
Filter chips use aria-pressed; search input labelled; results count announced in live region
Copy-path confirms via live region text

openQuestions: Does results screen need full per-resume table in UI or summary counts plus Excel download suffice for v1?
Should Cancel take user to partial results screen or stay on progress with stopped state?
Preferred display for screening date: Jalali only or Jalali plus Gregorian side by side?
